package.name: coco_mission
package.description:
Launch files that compose the whole Coco fetch mission: Nav2, the velocity arbiter, perception, MoveIt, the RL ramp driver, the platform approach and the grasp server.
It exists as its own package because of the dependency graph, not for tidiness. The natural home would have been gazebo_models, which owns the world and the sequencer script — but coco_moveit_config already depends on gazebo_models for the robot description, so a launch file in gazebo_models that starts move_group closes a cycle and colcon refuses to order the workspace at all. Whatever composes every layer has to sit above all of them.
The SIMULATOR is deliberately not part of this. One Gazebo runs at a time on this machine and the mission needs a fresh one per run (the DetachableJoint binds each target once, on first spawn), so starting it stays a separate, deliberate command.
